title: Offline deterministic Codex live provider adapter contract

request_response.payload: digest-only; no prompt, transcript, command, or provider payload
request_response.response: correlated by the exact outstanding request_id and represented only by an evidence digest
request_response.determinism: canonical JSON replay must produce the same result

privacy.projection: bounded identifiers, states, dispositions, and SHA-256 digests only

compatibility.canonical_json: UTF-8 JSON, sorted keys, compact separators, no trailing newline

limitations: The model, checker, and fixture are synthetic offline observations; they do not launch Codex, a provider, a process, network, LLM, Coordinator, AWQ, AWG, or UI.
Closed gates and a passing replay are not provider availability, authorization, model behavior, filesystem isolation, hosted-CI success, or remote execution.
A terminal local observation is not Coordinator completion, AWQ acceptance, AWG guidance, or a live provider result.
follow_up: A separately approved integration AR must bind a real provider only after Coordinator lease, credential, network, supervision, and human-approval gates are independently satisfied.
AWQ must independently qualify any evidence before release or publication.
